seafood-guide.name: Scotch Whisky Association — food pairing ideas

chocolate.guidance: Dark chocolate matches sherried Speyside and rich peat; the cocoa bitterness needs whiskey sweetness of equal intensity.

blue cheese.guidance: Sweetness and smoke beat salt: sweet sherried malts or peaty Islay both cut through a strong blue.

bbq.guidance: Bourbon's corn sweetness plays off char and sauce; Tennessee's charcoal mellowness suits smoke-heavy ribs.

smoked salmon.guidance: Smoke-to-smoke works: Islay peat echoes the fish's smokiness while briny malts match its cure.

oysters.guidance: Briny island malts are the classic pairing; a squeeze of lemon suits lightly peated coastal pours.

pecan pie.guidance: Caramel-and-nut desserts want wheated bourbon or sherried malt at equal sweetness.
